decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's natural facial-care know-how, the aloe vera line fits its existing formulation and sourcing capabilities well, and its dedicated presentation suggests enough commitment to justify continued learning and refinement.

The hyaluronic acid serum is closely related to the firm's core skincare business, so its existing knowledge base should let it interpret early market feedback and improve the product rather than withdraw it quickly.

The cleansing milk is also near the firm's established offer and can be supported by existing development and production routines, though its more limited website prominence makes it somewhat more at risk than the other two.
